name: DINS Santi Taura
lunchNote: Same menu at lunch · Fri–Sat (Sat only in summer)
lunchNoteEs: El mismo menú al mediodía · vie–sáb (solo sáb en verano)

menus.name: Origens tasting menu
menus.note: The only menu, lunch or dinner; Mallorcan cooking; pairing of five Balearic wines €80, or seven Spanish wines €120 (minimum two people); extra courses €5–18; filtered water included; 10% VAT included

alsoTry.name: Urbà
alsoTry.note: Santi Taura's other restaurant in the same hotel, run by his kitchen team; DINS suggests it for a lighter or cheaper meal

hotel: the hotel El Llorenç Parc de la Mar
bookingOpens: Online through the restaurant's website (TheFork), with a credit card to guarantee every booking, or by email. Phone line Monday to Friday, 9am to 3pm.
cancellation: Free cancellation up to 48 hours before the booking. Later cancellations, smaller parties and no-shows are charged €120 a person. Bookings more than 20 minutes late without warning are cancelled.
groups: Groups of six or more by email (reserves@santitaura.com). No private rooms; the whole restaurant (30 seats) can be booked for private events.
children: No one under 16, including babies: the hotel is adults only.

stay.name: El Llorenç Parc de la Mar
stay.note: Inside a 33-room adults-only (16+) design hotel in Palma’s old town; no children under 16 at the restaurant either.
